verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions document scheduled executions and cron jobs as a first-party trigger type, so recurring jobs are directly supported. The evidence is only brief marketing and overview lines, and nothing covers multi-step workflow orchestration. Messaging scheduling (docs-27) reads as one-off scheduled sends, not a recurring schedule, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on cron expression syntax and schedule configuration, recurring multi-step workflow orchestration, agent/MCP-driven schedule management evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand.
